note: v2514: A cold review named the upgrade: capture the arguments on call and assert they match, which proves both that the rule was called and that it was called correctly. Adopted - the patch is a spy recording pool, reach and sources. That closes two of its own other findings at once: an earlier assertion failing no longer satisfies the test, and nothing depends on a fragment of assertion prose. Its claim that a rename breaks the test silently is refuted - unittest raises ValueError at construction. And one of my sabotages went green because the sabotage was identical to the real call, not because the guard was weak.
